100×100 Stone Wainscot

Home Metal Building Siding 100x100 Stone Wainscot
Transform the look of your metal building or pole barn with a realistic stacked stone wainscot without the cost, weight, or labor of traditional masonry.
Designed specifically for a 100′ x 100′ building with a 4-foot-tall perimeter wainscot, this complete kit includes all GenStone components needed to create a professional finished appearance around the entire structure. Each kit is color-matched and engineered to provide a seamless installation with authentic stone detail and durable weather-resistant performance.
